title: Lab 5 - Build and publish the image, cache and templates
description: Docker-in-Docker, the Container Registry, a lock-file-keyed cache and a .node template.
scenario: Turn the tested app into an image published by SHA, cut install time with a cache, and fold the repetition into templates.
environment_setup:
# A gitlab.com account (free tier is enough) with shared runners enabled on the project,
# git on your machine, and a terminal. Keep Build → Pipelines open in a second tab.
git --version
git remote -v
cleanup: # Nothing to clean: pipelines and jobs are history. Delete the scratch project when the track is over.

tasks.title: Task 1 - Build with dind
tasks.instructions: Add a build stage job using docker:27 + docker:27-dind with the three TLS variables; docker build the Dockerfile tagged $CI_REGISTRY_IMAGE:$CI_COMMIT_SHORT_SHA.
tasks.verification: docker info succeeds in the log; the build completes.

tasks.title: Task 2 - Publish
tasks.instructions: Log in with CI_REGISTRY_USER/CI_REGISTRY_PASSWORD, push the SHA tag, and :latest only on the default branch. Restrict with rules to main and tags.
tasks.verification: Deploy → Container Registry lists the SHA tag (and latest after a main push).

tasks.title: Task 3 - Cache
tasks.instructions: Set npm_config_cache to $CI_PROJECT_DIR/.npm; cache .npm/ keyed on package-lock.json; use npm ci --prefer-offline. Compare install time across two pipelines.
tasks.verification: Second pipeline's log shows 'Restoring cache' and a faster npm ci.

tasks.title: Task 4 - Template
tasks.instructions: Create a hidden .node job with image, cache and before_script; make lint and unit-tests extend it. Check the Full configuration tab.
tasks.solution:
".node":
  image: node:20-alpine
  before_script: ["npm ci --prefer-offline"]
unit-tests: {extends: .node, script: ["npm test"]}
tasks.verification: Full configuration shows both jobs expanded with the template's keys; pipeline still green.
